## Projects

- [Alice Exam Proctor](https://github.com/adii0018/Alice-exam-proctor): Automated exam integrity monitoring detecting gaze deviation, multiple faces, and acoustic anomalies in real-time without human supervision.
- [Alice Mandi](https://github.com/adii0018/Alice-mandi): Direct farmer-to-buyer marketplace featuring ML price forecasting on regional mandi data and smart harvest logistics optimization.
- [JanSetu AI](https://github.com/adii0018/JanSetu-AI): Conversational welfare scheme assistant processing 12 regional dialects via retrieval-augmented LLM architecture and speech-to-text models.
- [FFZone Arena](https://github.com/adii0018/FFZONE): High-concurrency fantasy sports arena featuring live matchday data feeds, predictive AI lineup suggestions, and competitive leagues.
